name: Black Mountain College Museum and Arts Center
notes: Black Mountain College Museum + Arts Center, a small non-collecting museum in a storefront on College Street, downtown Asheville (no purpose-built museum building of its own; no photographs reachable, Wikimedia blocked). Modelled generically as the kind of two-and-a-half-storey early-20th-century brick commercial block that lines that street: a plain brick front, a flat roof behind a parapet, a glazed storefront at street level under a dark fascia/awning line, two upper storeys of paired windows, and the sidewalk in front. Guessed entirely: the real building's exact width, storey heights, window rhythm and colour — first model from the place and its downtown setting alone, not from any specific elevation.
